title: UI Contracts Schema
description: Describes what is visible on each screen or screen section: fields, display formats, labels, actions, visual states, and layout. Captures presentational details that do not fit in functional/non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, or acceptance tests.

title.description: Human-readable name of the screen or section.

description.description: Brief summary of what this screen or section shows the user.

section_path.description: Hierarchical navigation or organisational path, e.g. ["Accounts", "Account Detail"].

url_path.description: Route path without host (e.g. /accounts/:accountId). Used to group all screens, sections, dialogs, and overlays that appear on the same page.

parent_uic_id.description: Parent screen UIC id when this item is a section, dialog, or child surface of another screen.

page_section_id.description: Named widget slot or area within the page this item occupies, e.g. 'header', 'sidebar', 'account_summary_card', 'recent_transactions'.

sort_hint.description: Ordering hint among sibling items that share the same parent or url_path (lower numbers appear first).

fields.description: Fields displayed or collected on this screen/section.

actions.description: User-triggerable actions available on this screen/section.

states.description: Visual states the screen/section can be in.

layout_notes.description: Free-form description of layout, ordering, or grouping when the fields/actions arrays alone are not sufficient.

related_requirement_ids.description: FR or NFR ids this screen relates to, for traceability.

related_uic_ids.description: Other UI contracts closely related to this one (e.g. sibling tabs, sub-sections).

notes.description: Any additional presentational detail that does not fit the structured fields above.

label.description: Visible label shown to the user.

display_type.description: How the field value is displayed or collected.

editable.description: True when the user can modify the value (input field). False for display-only.

required.description: Whether the field is required for form submission (only meaningful when editable is true).

placeholder.description: Placeholder or hint text shown when the field is empty.

default_value.description: Default value shown on initial render.

options.description: Selectable options for select, multi_select, radio, or checkbox fields.

custom_rule.description: Plain-language description of a validation rule not expressible by the other fields.

validation.description: Client-side validation rules shown or enforced on the screen.

visibility_condition.description: Plain-language condition under which this field is shown, e.g. 'only when payment method is bank account'.

group.description: Logical grouping label when fields are visually grouped together.

sort_hint.description: Optional ordering hint within the screen (lower numbers appear first).

label.description: Visible text on the button, link, or control.

icon.description: Icon name or description shown with or instead of the label.

navigates_to.description: Target screen UIC id or route the action leads to.

confirmation_required.description: Whether a confirmation dialog is shown before executing the action.

enabled_condition.description: Plain-language condition under which this action is enabled.

description.description: What the user sees when the screen is in this state.
